# `⍋` — Grade up

Keys: `Alt-7 |`

`⍋Y` gives indices that sort major cells ascending. Stable; uses [structural ordering](../rules.qmd#equality-and-ordering), without tolerance. NaN sorts after every other number.

```bpl
⍋30 10 20          ⍝ [1 2 0]ₓ
v←30 10 20 ⋄ [⍋v]⌷v ⍝ 10 20 30
⍋2 1 2 1           ⍝ [1 3 0 2]ₓ
```

`C⍋Y` uses a character collation array `C`.

```bpl
"cba"⍋"abc"        ⍝ [2 1 0]ₓ
```

See [`⍒`](grade-down.qmd).
